title: Bangladesh Study Abroad & China University Cost Benchmark Dataset (2027)
description:
An open, evidence-verified higher-education cost and admissions dataset compiled for Bangladeshi students, parents, journalists, and education researchers by EduExpress International (https://eduexpressint.com, Dhanmondi, Dhaka).

  • 159 verified active institutions (150 Chinese universities across 61 cities + 9 Malaysian universities; 0 under verification).
  • 898 structured programs (521 English-taught China Bachelor programs, 118 Master's, 66 PhD).
  • 888 itemized non-tuition fee records separating university tuition from dormitory, medical insurance, residence permit, health check, and EMGS processing costs.
  • 276 scholarship tracks across CSC, Chinese provincial/city governments, Belt and Road, CLEC, and institutional awards.
  • 12-destination Bangladesh outbound comparison matrix documenting Bangladesh Bank AD Student File remittance rules vs. China on-campus/CSC payment pathways.

Live machine-readable endpoints and press briefs are maintained at https://eduexpressint.com/press. EduExpress International (Dhaka, Bangladesh) is an independent entity unaffiliated with UK-registered EduExpress Ltd.
notes: Tuition quartiles include strictly explicit single-year CNY program rows; non-tuition arrival fees are separated from tuition and never converted using synthetic exchange rates. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
